
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/22330955" title="发布于 2026-08-08 11:04">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十九）使用LangGraph实现持久记忆功能</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>上一篇文章介绍了如何使用InMemoryStore实现用户偏好的精确记忆功能，但记忆只保留在内存中，一旦AI应用重启，就会丢失上次在内存中的记忆数据。
<p>为了让AI应用持久记忆业务数据，就得引入文件或者数据库等存储介质，比如Python自带的轻量级数据库SQLite。接下来就介绍如何结合LangGraph与SQLite实现业务数据的持久记忆功能。</p>
<h1>一、Python中的SQLite用法</h1>
<p>安装Python时已经自带了SQLite包，在代码开头添加下面导包语句，即可引入SQLite包：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="10" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20sqlite3%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import sqlite3</code></pre>
</div>
<p>sqlite3的connect方法可创建SQLite的数据库连接，同时指定数据库的文件名称及其保存路径。若只填数据库文件名，则默认保存在当前程序目录下。<br>
connect方法返回的连接类型为Connection，它的常用方法说明如下：</p>
<p>backup：备份数据库。<br>
close：关闭数据库连接。<br>
commit：提交数据变更。<br>
rollback：回滚数据变更。</p>
<h1>二、LangGraph中的SQLite组件</h1>
<p>LangGraph中的SQLite组件包括SqliteStore和SqliteSaver，其中SqliteStore位于langgraph包，而SqliteSaver位于langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite插件。</p>
<p>在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可安装LangChain及其用到的Ollama插件，以及数据库记忆功能需要的LangGraph及其SQLite插件：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="9" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20langchain%20langchain-core%20langchain-ollama%20langgraph%20langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install langchain langchain-core langchain-ollama langgraph langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite</code></pre>
</div>
<p>由于之前使用的离线大模型Qwen2:1.5B不支持tool工具调用，因此得下载支持tool工具调用的离线大模型Qwen2.5:3B，也就是在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可下载大模型qwen2.5:3b：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20pull%20qwen2.5%3A3b%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama pull qwen2.5:3b</code></pre>
</div>
<p>等待大模型下载完毕，在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可启动Ollama并加载大模型：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20serve%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama serve</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>三、使用SQLite组件持久保存偏好数据</h1>
<p>与之前使用InMemoryStore保存记忆数据相比，引入SQLite插件之后的代码修改部分说明如下：</p>
<p>1、先导入SQLite状态保存器SqliteSaver和SQLite数据保存器SqliteStore的所在包，接着创建SQLite数据库连接，再根据数据库连接分别创建状态保存器实例和数据保存器实例。示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20sqlite3%5Cn%23%20%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8SqliteStore%E6%9B%BF%E6%8D%A2InMemoryStore%5Cnfrom%20langgraph.store.sqlite%20import%20SqliteStore%5Cnfrom%20langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite%20import%20SqliteSaver%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%BA%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%5Cncheck_conn%3D%20sqlite3.connect(%5C%22agent.db%5C%22%2C%20check_same_thread%3DFalse%2C%20isolation_level%3DNone)%5Cn%23%20%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%99%A8%EF%BC%8C%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E7%BA%BF%E7%A8%8B%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%EF%BC%8C%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%BB%BA%20checkpoints%20%2F%20writes%20%E8%A1%A8%5Cncheckpointer%20%3D%20SqliteSaver(check_conn)%5Cn%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%BA%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%5Cnstore_conn%3D%20sqlite3.connect(%5C%22agent.db%5C%22%2C%20check_same_thread%3DFalse%2C%20isolation_level%3DNone)%5Cn%23%20%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%99%A8%EF%BC%8C%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BA%8B%E5%AE%9E%20%2F%20%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E8%AE%B0%E5%BF%86%EF%BC%8C%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%BB%BA%20store_namespaces%20%2F%20store_items%20%E8%A1%A8%5Cnstore_db%20%3D%20SqliteStore(store_conn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import sqlite3
# 使用SqliteStore替换InMemoryStore
from langgraph.store.sqlite import SqliteStore
from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver

# 创建数据库连接
check_conn= sqlite3.connect("agent.db", check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=None)
# 状态保存器，保存对话线程运行状态，自动建 checkpoints / writes 表
checkpointer = SqliteSaver(check_conn)
# 创建数据库连接
store_conn= sqlite3.connect("agent.db", check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=None)
# 数据保存器，保存用户事实 / 工具记忆，自动建 store_namespaces / store_items 表
store_db = SqliteStore(store_conn)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>2、在创建大模型实例时，既要将温度参数temperature设为0表示严格按照提示词执行，也要将工具选择参数tool_choice设为any表示强制模型必须调用工具。示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22llm%20%3D%20ChatOllama(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3D%5C%22qwen2.5%3A3b%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20temperature%3D0.0%2C%20%C2%A0%23%200%E6%B8%A9%E5%BA%A6%EF%BC%8C%E6%B6%88%E9%99%A4%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E8%83%A1%E6%80%9D%E4%B9%B1%E6%83%B3%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%A5%E6%A0%BC%E6%8C%89prompt%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20num_ctx%3D8192%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%23%20%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%EF%BC%9A%E6%8F%90%E5%89%8D%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%2B%E5%BC%BA%E5%88%B6%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5%5Cntools_list%20%3D%20%5Bremember_user_preference%2C%20get_user_preference%5D%5Cn%23%20tool_choice%3D%5C%22any%5C%22%20%E7%AD%89%E4%BB%B7required%EF%BC%8C%E5%BC%BA%E5%88%B6%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%BF%85%E9%A1%BB%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%5Cnllm_temp%20%3D%20llm.bind_tools(tools_list%2C%20tool_choice%3D%5C%22any%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">llm = ChatOllama(
&nbsp; &nbsp; model="qwen2.5:3b",
&nbsp; &nbsp; temperature=0.0, &nbsp;# 0温度，消除随机胡思乱想，严格按prompt执行
&nbsp; &nbsp; num_ctx=8192
&nbsp; &nbsp; )
# 关键：提前绑定工具+强制工具策略
tools_list = [remember_user_preference, get_user_preference]
# tool_choice="any" 等价required，强制模型必须输出工具调用
llm_temp = llm.bind_tools(tools_list, tool_choice="any")</code></pre>
</div>
<p>3、在调用create_agent创建智能体实例时，把store参数改为上一步创建的数据保存器实例store_db，把checkpointer参数改为上一步创建的状态保存器实例checkpointer；还要编写提示词参数system_prompt，指定详细的工具调用规则。示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%8F%90%E5%88%B0%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8remember_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%EF%BC%9B%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%AF%A2%E9%97%AE%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8get_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E3%80%82%5Cnagent%20%3D%20create_agent(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3Dllm%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20context_schema%3DContext%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20tools%3Dtools_list%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20store%3Dstore_db%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20checkpointer%3Dcheckpointer%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20system_prompt%3D%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BD%A0%E6%98%AF%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%AE%B0%E5%BF%86%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%A5%E6%A0%BC%E9%81%B5%E5%AE%88%E4%BB%A5%E4%B8%8B%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99%EF%BC%9A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%201.%20%E5%8F%AA%E8%A6%81%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%B8%BB%E5%8A%A8%E8%AF%B4%E5%87%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84%E5%96%9C%E5%A5%BD%E3%80%81%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%88%E6%AF%94%E5%A6%82%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E3%80%81%E9%A3%9F%E7%89%A9%E3%80%81%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%8C**%E6%97%A0%E8%AE%BA%E4%B9%8B%E5%89%8D%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E8%BF%87%E5%90%8C%E7%B1%BB%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%B0%B1%E5%BF%85%E9%A1%BB%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%20remember_user_preference%20%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E8%A6%86%E7%9B%96**%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8D%E8%83%BD%E8%B7%B3%E8%BF%87%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%EF%BC%9B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%202.%20%E5%8F%AA%E8%A6%81%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%B8%BB%E5%8A%A8%E8%AF%A2%E9%97%AE%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%B0%B1%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%20get_user_preference%20%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E6%9F%A5%E8%AF%A2%EF%BC%9B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%203.%20%E7%A6%81%E6%AD%A2%E7%9C%81%E7%95%A5%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%EF%BC%9A%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E5%8E%9F%E6%9C%89%E5%96%9C%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%BF%85%E9%A1%BB%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%EF%BC%9B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%204.%20%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%E5%90%8E%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E5%90%91%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%87%AA%E7%84%B6%E5%9B%9E%E5%A4%8D%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># 用户提到喜欢什么东西时，会调用remember_user_preference工具；用户询问喜欢什么东西时，会调用get_user_preference工具。
agent = create_agent(
&nbsp; &nbsp; model=llm,
&nbsp; &nbsp; context_schema=Context,
&nbsp; &nbsp; tools=tools_list,
&nbsp; &nbsp; store=store_db,
&nbsp; &nbsp; checkpointer=checkpointer,
&nbsp; &nbsp; system_prompt="""
&nbsp; &nbsp; 你是用户记忆助手，严格遵守以下规则：
&nbsp; &nbsp; 1. 只要用户主动说出自己的喜好、偏好（比如喜欢的颜色、食物、风格），**无论之前是否存储过同类偏好，就必须调用 remember_user_preference 工具更新覆盖**，不能跳过工具直接回答；
&nbsp; &nbsp; 2. 只要用户主动询问自己的偏好，就调用 get_user_preference 工具查询；
&nbsp; &nbsp; 3. 禁止省略存储工具：用户修改原有喜好，必须调用工具更新数据；
&nbsp; &nbsp; 4. 工具调用完成后，再向用户自然回复。
&nbsp; &nbsp; """
)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>4、在调用智能体实例的invoke方法时，增加传入config参数，指定SQLite组件所需的线程编号。示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20result%20%3D%20agent.invoke(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22messages%5C%22%3A%20%5BHumanMessage(content%3Duser_input)%5D%7D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20context%3DContext(user_id%3D%5C%22user_123%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20config%3D%7B%5C%22configurable%5C%22%3A%20%7B%5C%22thread_id%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22session-001%5C%22%7D%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">&nbsp; &nbsp; # 调用离线大模型
&nbsp; &nbsp; result = agent.invoke(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_input)]},
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; context=Context(user_id="user_123"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config={"configurable": {"thread_id": "session-001"}}
&nbsp; &nbsp; )</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行修改后的Python代码，根据提示输入问题内容“我喜欢蓝色”，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%9A%E6%88%91%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E8%93%9D%E8%89%B2%5CnAI%EF%BC%9A%E6%88%91%E5%B7%B2%E7%BB%8F%E8%AE%B0%E4%BD%8F%E4%BA%86%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%A0%E7%8E%B0%E5%9C%A8%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E6%98%AF%E8%93%9D%E8%89%B2%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E4%BD%A0%E6%9C%89%E5%85%B6%E4%BB%96%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E7%9A%84%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%E6%88%96%E8%80%85%E6%83%B3%E8%A6%81%E6%94%B9%E5%8F%98%E7%8E%B0%E6%9C%89%E7%9A%84%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E5%91%8A%E8%AF%89%E6%88%91%EF%BC%81%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">用户：我喜欢蓝色
AI：我已经记住了，你现在喜欢的颜色是蓝色。如果你有其他颜色的偏好或者想要改变现有的偏好，请告诉我！</code></pre>
</div>
<p>停止当前AI应用进程，重新运行Python代码，根据提示输入问题内容“我喜欢什么颜色？”，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%9A%E6%88%91%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%EF%BC%9F%5CnAI%EF%BC%9A%E6%82%A8%E7%8E%B0%E5%9C%A8%E6%9C%80%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E6%98%AF%E8%93%9D%E8%89%B2%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E6%9C%89%E5%85%B6%E4%BB%96%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E6%88%96%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E8%BF%9B%E4%B8%80%E6%AD%A5%E5%B8%AE%E5%8A%A9%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E9%9A%8F%E6%97%B6%E5%91%8A%E8%AF%89%E6%88%91%EF%BC%81%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">用户：我喜欢什么颜色？
AI：您现在最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。如果有其他问题或需要进一步帮助，请随时告诉我！</code></pre>
</div>
<p>由日志信息发现，在应用程序重启前后，AI应用均能正确回答用户的颜色偏好，并且当前目录找到了数据库文件agent.db。可见在引入LangGraph的SQLite组件之后，LangChain成功实现了用户数据的持久记忆功能。</p>
